## Modify Darkness Pulse

---

[Power Type](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki/Power-Types)

Modifies the strength of the pulsing visual effect caused by [darkness](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Darkness).

Type ID: `proviorigins:modify_darkness_pulse`

## Fields

---

## Examples
```json
{
    "type": "proviorigins:modify_darkness_pulse",
    "multiplier": 0
}
```
This power removed the pulsing effect of darkness.

x-intellij-html-description:
Power Type

Modifies the strength of the pulsing visual effect caused by darkness.

Type ID: proviorigins:modify_darkness_pulse

Fields

Field Type Default Description
multiplier Float 1.0 Applied first, the darkness modifer is multiplied by this value.
addition Float 0 Applied second, this value is added to the darkness modifier.

The darkness modifier is calculated as:
darknessModifier = darknessModifier * multiplier + addition

Examples

{
    "type": "proviorigins:modify_darkness_pulse",
    "multiplier": 0
}

This power removed the pulsing effect of darkness.
